title: Karl Maria Wiligut, Himmler's SS seer of the Nordic past

tellings.quote: source in a guy called Vice, Carl Villigut, right? who claimed he had photographic memory of what it was like back in the day when there were only Nordics on the planet.

plain: In 1930s Nazi Germany, a man named Karl Maria Wiligut claimed he had a photographic memory of the distant past "when there were only Nordics on the planet," and he became a source of ideas for Heinrich Himmler, head of the SS, the Nazi party's elite guard. The researcher Peter Levenda tells this without naming a source. If true, it would mean Nazi beliefs about race came in part from one man's claimed memories of a lost age.
